risk_assessment.weather_context_status: No point-in-time future weather forecast snapshot has been connected to this inference module.
risk_assessment.interpretation: Demand category is based on fixed training-period P80/P90/P95 percentiles. It is statistical demand pressure, not a physical grid-overload or reserve-margin assessment.

limitations: The models predict one day ahead, not multiple days recursively.
The model bundles were trained with historical weather predictors.
For this first inference build, the latest historical weather feature row is carried forward; it is not a weather forecast.
Weather context remains not_assessed until point-in-time forecast snapshots with fetched_at and valid_time are integrated.
Forecast quality depends on refreshing observed electricity demand and rebuilding the fused feature dataset.
P80/P90/P95 categories are statistical demand-pressure labels, not verified physical grid stress.
